papers.abstract: We present a novel analytical framework for evaluating the age of information (AoI) in multi-path queueing topologies where output streams from multiple servers converge into a single pipeline. This theoretical scenario finds immediate application in ultra-reliable low-latency networks and edge computing architectures, where multi-path routing and stream merging can be vital strategies for maintaining fresh status updates.
